title: Podcast starter config
description: The settings of the podcast site, as they are in _config.yml.

author.description: Who makes the show. The name is shown in the feed and in the author box.

name.description: The name of the host or the studio.

description.description: One sentence about the show, used in the feed and in link previews.

lang.description: The language of the show, as a BCP 47 tag such as en or fa.

plugins.description: The GitHub Pages plugins the site uses.

items.description: The name of a plugin, such as jekyll-remote-theme.

header.description: How the header is laid out. centered stacks the title and the navigation.

theme.description: The theme gem the site uses, or null with remote_theme in the overlay.

title.description: The name of the show, shown in the header and in the feed.

url.description: The address the site is published at, without a trailing slash. Podcast directories need it for the absolute URLs in the feed.
